source_sections: 10-Q Note 6, Assets and Liabilities by Hierarchy Level
10-Q MD&A Valuation of Assets and Liabilities, PFI excluding Closed Block and Funds Withheld
original_sec.source_review_method: Manual same-filing cross-table arithmetic; NOT a fresh independent rehash of extracted Level 3 fields

scope: PFI excluding Closed Block Division and Funds Withheld (NOT PRU total consolidated, not separate-account customer risk)

separate_consolidated_note6_scope_not_ad.note: These are consolidated Note 6 Level 3 AFS/ABS amounts, NOT incremental assets on top of the PFI-excluding-Closed-Block/Funds-Withheld population. ABS is within AFS, and the population boundaries differ.

interpretation: Most PFI-excluding-Closed-Block/Funds-Withheld Level 3 fixed maturities in the 2026 September disclosure are privately placed ($12,510m of $13,664m); this is valuation opacity, not automatic impairment.
The $2,382m increase compares two balance dates disclosed in the eligible November 2026 10-Q. It is NOT a 2025-12 PIT historical observation.
PFI excluded-population and consolidated Note 6 disclosures overlap: never add them together.
Trading plus AFS reconciles private plus public Level 3 fixed maturities exactly; this does not certify the independent historical source-delivery timestamp.
Prudential September filing is SEC+14 eligible on Nov 19, unlike MetLife September filing (eligible Nov 20); the two insurer periods are not synchronized.
